supporting_observations.claim: FILE-HD-01 launched the documented CobaltVault agent as HARBOR-DENTAL\svc-bkp with the Nightly job targeting ingest.cobaltvault.net shortly before the alert time.

The agent contacted the expected CobaltVault endpoint through the proxy, but the recorded session shows only small setup/response byte counts and a GET of the endpoint root; a later connection was denied with HTTP 407, and the agent then exited.
The supplied records do not establish that the alerted hundreds-of-megabytes transfer occurred: the CobaltVault records show a failed/short session rather than evidence of a bulk upload.

known_telemetry_limitations: The evidence does not include a flow or proxy record identifying the destination, exact byte count, and process for the reported large transfer around 13:46 UTC.
The CobaltVault proxy records describe its brief session, but do not establish whether a separate transfer occurred, whether traffic bypassed the proxy, or what data was sent.
claims_not_established: That the large outbound transfer described in the alert is the CobaltVault backup upload.
That hundreds of megabytes were transferred during the recorded CobaltVault session, or that the backup completed successfully.
The destination, payload, and responsible process for the alerted transfer.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the alert's underlying network-flow or sensor record, including exact start/end time, destination, byte counts, and available process attribution.
Collect proxy and firewall/egress records for FILE-HD-01 covering the alert window, including any direct or bypass traffic.
Obtain CobaltVault agent/job logs for the run, including upload byte counts and success or failure status.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: FILE-HD-01 proxy activity used a GlobalProtect user agent for updates.paloaltonetworks.com and Zscaler Client Connector user agents for Zscaler endpoints; these are not listed among approved services in the supplied context, but the records alone do not establish malicious activity. (T010-00123, T010-00234, T010-00271, T010-00277, T010-00473)

Separate review: FILE-HD-01 made a proxy request to downloads.cloud.com with a curl user agent. This is outside the listed approved services, but the record does not establish that it was file sharing or related to the alerted transfer. (T010-00515)
